summary: Keep project-guidance responses within the existing output contract and clearly separate truncated AI failures from local fallback text.

budget_impact.rationale: The project_guidance operation keeps its approved 1200 input / 500 output envelope, one request per click, existing provider, frequency and privacy scope. The system instruction is shorter than the prior placeholder graph example; local bounding only limits complete string fields and never retries or accepts partial JSON. Core recurring operations remain zero model tokens.
budget_impact.before: Existing project_guidance 1200 input / 500 output contract; truncated or overproduced replies degraded to local mode with a misleading shorten-input reason.
budget_impact.after: Same 1200 input / 500 output contract; concrete graph only, bounded string fields, explicit output-limit diagnosis, and a distinct local-fallback label.
budget_impact.developer_usage: 14 real DeepSeek development calls through the existing Gateway in PDH_DEV=1 and an isolated temporary data directory: 4,225 tokens and $0.0029838, pending reservations 0. Formal user data, formal key and formal runtime ledger were not used or changed.

quantified.period: single request arithmetic at peak cache-miss pricing; not a billing guarantee

open_risks: The 14 real development calls cover the reported response contract and bounded cases, not general scientific guidance quality or billing/tokenizer parity.
A finish_reason=length response remains a safe local fallback; the app does not save or continue partial JSON automatically.
